zh.title: 星宇航空稱颱風CHAMPI影響下部分航班可能調整
zh.summary: 星宇航空表示，颱風CHAMPI影響下，部分航班可能調整。
body: 星宇航空表示，受颱風CHAMPI影響，部分航班可能出現時刻異動。公告請旅客查看「Flight Updates」取得最新資訊，也可查詢「Timetable」或「Flight status」服務。
公告表示，颱風期間客服電話目前來電量較高。受航班異動影響的旅客可透過線上表單提交需求，客服人員將儘快聯絡。星宇航空並為造成不便致歉，感謝旅客理解。

en.title: STARLUX Says Some Flights May Change During Typhoon CHAMPI
en.summary: STARLUX says some flights may face schedule changes due to Typhoon CHAMPI.
body: STARLUX Airlines says some flights may be subject to schedule changes due to Typhoon CHAMPI. The notice directs passengers to check Flight Updates for the latest information, or consult the airline’s timetable or flight-status service.

The airline says its customer-service phone lines are experiencing high call volumes during the typhoon period. Passengers affected by flight changes are advised to submit requests through an online form, and customer-service staff will contact them as soon as possible. STARLUX apologized for the inconvenience and thanked passengers for their understanding.
